project_type: React 18 SPA with PHP Slim 4 backend and Supabase Edge Functions
test_framework: No frontend test framework, PHPUnit for backend
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm build to verify frontend compiles. 2. Run tsc in workers/ to verify Worker TypeScript compiles.
setup_instructions: pnpm install in root; cd workers && npm install for worker deps
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Node 22 available. pnpm available.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode, use path aliases (@/) for imports, follow existing component patterns
key_patterns: Frontend uses @/services/php.ts as the API client (PhpApiClient class with JWT forwarding). Three files import from @/services/php: routing.ts, fulfillment.ts, invoices.ts. Supabase Edge Function at supabase/functions/ai-chat/index.ts has full RAG pipeline with tool calling, rate limiting, SSE streaming, and multi-provider fallback (OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic). Excel service at src/services/excel/ has parser, generator, templates, and routing (client/server split at 5MB). PHP InvoiceController uses DomPDF with Indian currency formatting (Rupees, Crore, Lakh).
directory_structure: Root: React SPA (Vite). src/services/ has ai/, excel/, sales/, crm/, inventory/, barcode/, branches/, php.ts. server/php/ has Slim 4 backend with Controllers/, Services/, Middleware/. supabase/functions/ai-chat/ has edge function. docs/ has deployment.md. .github/workflows/ has ci.yml.
